entities.name: Shilhak-Inshushinak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shilhak-Inshushinak I was king of Elam from about 1150 to 1120 BC and a member of the Shutrukid ruling dynasty. He was the son of Shutruk-Nahhunte I.
